notes: createFreshWorldSlot writes only slot.json -- no world.zip and no world_folders are touched (lines 577-585) -- so the slot is archive-less by construction; `activateSlot` later detects this via `!hasArchivedZip` (line 666-667) and generates a new world on first activation instead of extracting anything. `name` is stored trimmed but otherwise as-typed (line 570, 555), while `worldLevelName` runs through `sanitizedWorldLevelName(trimmedName, fallback: ...)` (line 562) -- for both cases here the trimmed name has no invalid characters, so the two fields happen to match, but they are not the same value in general (see sanitized-level-name-strips-invalid-characters.json). `worldSeed` is trimmed and normalized to nil when blank (lines 563-564, 407-408's twin in createSlot) -- case 2's all-whitespace seed becomes nil rather than an empty string. lastPlayedAt stays nil until the slot is actually activated (line 572), matching every other slot-creation path in this file.
